# Chris Donovan — Vendor Rep, TrailTech Footwear

- **Relationship:** **external** — the account rep for **TrailTech**, the store's biggest footwear vendor.
- **Cadence:** visits the store roughly monthly to check the footwear wall; reachable by text otherwise.
- **Owns (from Marc's side):** footwear replenishment, defective **RTV** credits, seasonal set changes, and
  **co-op marketing dollars** for footwear endcaps. Primary in-store contact is
  [Danny Okafor](../people/danny-okafor.md).
- **What Marc wants from him:** faster RTV turnaround (credits have been slow), and co-op support for the
  [Endcap Reset — Summer](../projects/endcap-reset-summer.md) footwear feature.
- **How to work with him:** relationship-driven; he'll go to bat on allocation if Marc gives him steady
  sell-through data and doesn't sit on returns.
